name: GW Under Construction Mode
author: Green Website

sections.description:
GW Under Construction Mode is a simple yet powerful plugin that lets you put your WordPress site into maintenance mode while you work on it.

Features include:

  • Enable/disable with a click.
  • Customize title and message.
  • Light or dark theme switch.
  • IP whitelisting for external testing.
  • Upload your logo or header image.
  • Responsive and clean design.

Useful for developers, site owners, and agencies who want to control site visibility during updates or launch prep.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Go to GW Plugins > Under Construction Mode to configure the settings.
sections.faq:
Can logged-in users still view the site?

Yes. Logged-in users are always allowed to see the site normally.

Can I whitelist multiple IP addresses?

Yes, just enter them separated by commas.

Why isn’t the Under Construction page turning off?

This usually happens when a caching plugin is active. Try clearing the cache or temporarily disabling any cache-related plugins. Make sure they’re configured to reflect changes immediately.

Where can I get help?

Visit https://www.greenwebsite.net/wordpress
